### Coupled Farquhar-Collatz and Ball-Berry Leaf Model Implementation & Verification

The coupled photosynthesis and stomatal conductance model has been implemented in `analysis.py`, executed over the complete 5-day forcing series (`data/forcing.csv`) and single-point test cases (`data/test_cases.json`), and the results and visualization have been saved under `results/`.

---

### Key Diagnostics & Numerical Verification

#### 1. Single-Point Test Case Convergence (`results/case_convergence.csv`)
All test cases evaluate the coupled model at solar noon (`forcing_index: 12`, $t = 12.0$ hr, $T_{\text{air}} = 292.67\ \text{K}$, $PAR_{\text{sun}} = 1792.72\ \text{W m}^{-2}$, $p_{\text{atm}} = 101325\ \text{Pa}$, $c_a = 64.065\ \text{Pa}$, $h_s = 0.40$).
Starting from widely varying initial guesses of internal $\text{CO}_2$ ($C_{i,\text{init}} = 0.1\ c_a$ to $1.1\ c_a$), the fixed-point solver converges monotonically to the exact coupled state:

| case_id | ci_init_pa | ci_final_pa | A_final ($\mu\text{mol m}^{-2}\text{s}^{-1}$) | rs_final ($\text{s m}^{-1}$) | n_iterations |
|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| `case_00` | 6.406459 | 31.205649 | 39.174335 | 167.393247 | 3 |
| `case_01` | 19.219376 | 31.205649 | 39.174335 | 167.393247 | 3 |
| `case_02` | 35.235522 | 31.205649 | 39.174335 | 167.393247 | 2 |
| `case_03` | 57.658127 | 31.205649 | 39.174335 | 167.393247 | 2 |
| `case_04` | 70.471044 | 31.205649 | 39.174335 | 167.393247 | 2 |

- **Mechanism**: Cases starting below the Rubisco-PEP transition ($C_i < 25.32\ \text{Pa}$) begin with transport/PEP limitation ($W_e$), taking 3 iterations. Cases starting above $25.32\ \text{Pa}$ immediately enter the Rubisco-limited plateau ($W_c$), converging in 2 iterations to machine precision ($\Delta C_i = 0.0$).

---

#### 2. Multi-Day Diurnal Simulation Summary (`results/leaf_fluxes.csv`)
The 120-hour forcing series captures 5 complete diurnal cycles:

| Variable | Unit | Min | Mean | Max |
|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| $A_{\text{sun}}$ | $\mu\text{mol CO}_2\ \text{m}^{-2}\ \text{s}^{-1}$ | -0.4938 | 15.8074 | 41.9528 |
| $A_{\text{shade}}$ | $\mu\text{mol CO}_2\ \text{m}^{-2}\ \text{s}^{-1}$ | -0.4938 | 14.4975 | 41.9528 |
| $r_{s,\text{sun}}$ | $\text{s m}^{-1}$ | 107.2254 | 652.6105 | 1082.3925 |
| $r_{s,\text{shade}}$ | $\text{s m}^{-1}$ | 124.4297 | 660.0537 | 1082.3925 |
| $C_{i,\text{sun}}$ | $\text{Pa}$ | 31.2056 | 52.8984 | 66.5063 |
| $C_{i,\text{shade}}$ | $\text{Pa}$ | 31.2056 | 53.1876 | 66.5063 |
| $g_{s,\text{sun}}$ | $\text{mol m}^{-2}\ \text{s}^{-1}$ | 0.0400 | 0.1510 | 0.3896 |
| $g_{s,\text{shade}}$ | $\text{mol m}^{-2}\ \text{s}^{-1}$ | 0.0400 | 0.1381 | 0.3340 |

- **Day/Night Transition**: At night ($PAR \le 10^{-4}\ \text{W m}^{-2}$), assimilation is purely respiratory ($A = -R_d \in [-0.49, -0.23]\ \mu\text{mol m}^{-2}\text{s}^{-1}$), stomatal conductance adheres strictly to the intercept ($g_s = b_0 = 0.040\ \text{mol m}^{-2}\text{s}^{-1}$), stomatal resistance rises to $c_f / b_0 \approx 1050\text{--}1082\ \text{s m}^{-1}$, and $C_i$ reflects outward diffusion ($C_i > c_s > c_a$).
- **Midday Peaks**: Peak assimilation reaches $41.95\ \mu\text{mol m}^{-2}\text{s}^{-1}$, stomatal conductance opens up to $0.390\ \text{mol m}^{-2}\text{s}^{-1}$ ($r_s \approx 107.2\ \text{s m}^{-1}$), pulling internal $\text{CO}_2$ down to $31.21\ \text{Pa}$.

---

#### 3. Visualization (`results/diurnal.png`)
The generated figure provides a publication-quality 2-panel diurnal plot:
- **Top Panel**: Net assimilation rate $A$ over time (0 to 120 hr) for sunlit and shaded leaves, including the zero baseline and nighttime respiration.
- **Bottom Panel**: Stomatal resistance $r_s$ over time (0 to 120 hr) showing day/night stomatal opening and nighttime closure dynamics.

---

### Artifacts Created
- `analysis.py`: Complete, standalone Python script implementing the model functions, solver, simulation workflow, and figure generator.
- `results/leaf_fluxes.csv`: 120 rows with columns `time_hr, A_sun, A_shade, rs_sun, rs_shade, ci_sun, ci_shade, gs_sun, gs_shade`.
- `results/case_convergence.csv`: 5 evaluation records with columns `case_id, ci_init_pa, ci_final_pa, A_final, rs_final, n_iterations`.
- `results/diurnal.png`: Two-panel visualization of diurnal flux and resistance dynamics.
